title: NF Research Tools - Animal Model
description: An animal sufficiently like humans in its anatomy, physiology, or response to a pathogen to be used in medical research in order to obtain results that can be extrapolated to human medicine.

aiSummary.description: A large language model-generated summary of the resource.

animalState.description: State the animal is in according to the vendor/developer (e.g. embryo, sperm, live).

backgroundStrain.description: The genetic background strain name. Correct strain nomenclature indicates what a mutant strain's background is.

backgroundSubstrain.description: The substrain variety of a strain (e.g. C57BL/6J, C57BL/6Tac).

clinicalTranslationHistory.description: Known instances where findings from this model did or did not translate to human clinical outcomes.

dateAdded.description: The date that the resource was originally added.

dateModified.description: The last update of the resource metadata.

description.description: Free text description, summary, or purpose of the resource.

donor.description: Foreign key to Donor (donorId). The biological donor from which the resource was derived.

generation.description: The generation of the animal model (e.g. 13).

geneticDisorder.description: Genetic disorders associated with the resource.

howToAcquire.description: How to acquire a particular resource.

humanizationMethod.description: For humanized mouse models, the method used to engraft human immune system components (e.g., HSC engraftment, PBMC transfer, BLT model).

immuneSystemComponents.description: For humanized mouse models, the human immune cell populations engrafted.

inducedVsDevelopmental.description: Whether this is an induced tumor model (tumor introduced experimentally) or a developmental model (tumor arises through genetic programming).

manifestation.description: Manifestations or symptoms that this resource is used to model (e.g. tumor type, behavioral phenotype).

mechanismOfActionValidation.description: Drug mechanisms of action that have been successfully tested in this model.

modelLimitations.description: Explicit description of what this model does NOT recapitulate or where it may produce false positive/negative results.

mtaRequired.description: Whether a Material Transfer Agreement is required to access this model.

ngnriRepositoryStatus.description: Whether this model is deposited in the Nick Gilbert Neurofibromatosis Research Institute (NGNRI) repository for equitable access.

pediatricSuitability.description: Whether this model is suitable for studying pediatric, adult, or both age groups.

pkpdCapabilities.description: Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic measurements that can be performed in this model.

regulatoryAcceptanceHistory.description: Known FDA/EMA precedents where data from this model type supported a regulatory submission or approval.

resourceId.description: A unique identifier for the resource.

resourceName.description: The canonical name of the resource.

routeOfAdministration.description: Drug delivery routes that have been validated or are feasible in this model.

rrid.description: The RRID, a standard resource identifier for interoperability with other databases. Must include the lowercase 'rrid:' prefix.

strainNomenclature.description: The standard nomenclature for the strain (e.g. B6.129S2-NF1tm1Tyj/J). Set by the International Committee on Standardized Genetic Nomenclature for Mice.

timelineToResults.description: Estimated time from experiment start to primary endpoint readout.

transplantationDonor.description: Foreign key to Donor (donorId). The donor used in transplantation experiments.

usageRequirements.description: Any known restrictions on use of the resource.

enum: generation of germ line transmitting chimeras not permitted
creation of functional gametes not permitted
generation of interspecies chimeras not permitted
cannot be used for treatment purposes
special licencing restrictions (see vendor for more information)
